items.title: Deploy Amazon S3 Object Lock with Cross-Region Replication and KMS encryption using AWS CloudFormation
items.summary: Learn how to deploy Amazon S3 Object Lock, cross-Region replication, and SSE-KMS encryption together as infrastructure as code with AWS CloudFormation. This post uses a three-stack pattern that correctly replicates Object Lock retention state and KMS-encrypted objects across two Regions for compliant, encrypted, WORM-protected storage.
items.creator: Ranvir Singh
categories: Server-side encryption using AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS)
